messages:
Maya (AM): quick sync — Montclair Health POC kickoff today, need to lock success criteria and who is owning which deliverables
Sam (SE): got it. I can cover infra + integration runbook. how much SE time do we commit for week1?
Alex (AE): customer asked for 2 days on-site remote support and then async after. propose 8h week1, 4h week2 for SE engagement.
Maya (AM): sounds fine. Major ask from buyer: HIPAA data flow, audit log sampling, and end-to-end evals on their prompts.
Priya (Security): can provide DHF and DLP checklist. need their network CIDRs and whether they want KMS or our managed keys. also will require Data Processing Addendum signed.
Jordan (Infra): if they want VPC peering for Private deployment we'll need their infra contact and an IP plan. otherwise Dedicated with TLS + KMS works.
Sam (SE): for acceptance criteria propose: 1) latency p95 < 400ms for 512-token prompts, 2) end-to-end correctness > 85% on their eval set, 3) audit logs available in S3 for 30d.
Maya (AM): customer agreed to those high-level goals in call, but asked for concrete eval prompts. Sam — can you draft a minimal eval harness they can run and we can reproduce?
Sam (SE): yes. I'll put together a small harness and a sample prompt set. plan: run harness against hosted API and dedicated variant. deliverables: harness repo link, instructions, sample DATA (sanitized).
Sam (SE): snippet for harness run:
```
# run local eval
python eval.py --model redwood-dedicated-v1 --prompts prompts.json --out results.json
```
Maya (AM): Priya — timeline for security review? they want to finish questionnaire within 5 business days.
Priya (Security): I'll start Qs today. need: security questionnaire PDF, SSO requirements, and whether they'd accept our SOC2 report. also clarify retention for logs (default 30d or extended).
Alex (AE): on pricing — they asked about POC credits vs committed pricing. propose we offer 10k free inference units and then bill at dedicated pilot rate if they go past that.
Maya (AM): ok. I'll propose that in the SOW. SE staffing: Sam, Jordan — can you both mark availability for Wed/Thu deep-dive?
Sam (SE): Wed morning works. I'll block 4h.
Jordan (Infra): Thu afternoon for peering work if needed.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging cluster prep for Montclair-POC at 2024-11-15T09:00Z by infra-team
Maya (AM): final action list: - Sam: eval harness + prompts (EOD Tue) - Priya: start sec review & DPA checklist (EOD Tue) - Jordan: prepare VPC checklist and peering doc (Thu) - Alex: draft SOW with 10k credits and pilot pricing (EOD Wed) - Maya: consolidate and send kickoff note to customer (once above in)
Sam (SE): will add a simple smoke test to harness that validates KV cache and batching behavior.
Priya (Security): will attach our SOC2 and the KMS integration doc to the questionnaire reply.
Maya (AM): perfect. I'll post an update once I hear back from the customer on infra contact. thanks all :thumbsup:
